one_liner: Zach LaVine shoots 41.4 percent from three and 49.3 percent overall at 22.7 points per 36 minutes.
three_things: 41.4 percent from deep is the highest three-point mark in this marquee set.
The overall 49.3 percent is unusual for a guard with that shot diet.
Availability is the caveat: 138 games, among the fewest here.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. The three-point comparison is scoped to the players with insight files in this set.
